name: User authentication and executive dashboard inspection
description: User logs in, views the main dashboard metrics, and inspects the multi-period attendance and payroll trend charts.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the application home page and submit valid admin credentials on the login form
Verify the user is redirected to the main dashboard and the active user profile name and role badge are visible in the top header bar
Scroll to the multi-period trends section on the dashboard and select 6 months from the range dropdown
Verify the trend table updates with monthly attendance rates and payroll pending counts laid out cleanly
